semantics.confidence_score: Deterministic reliability score from current data quality, evidence coverage, source provenance, signal agreement, attribution support, and upstream risk confidence. It is not a probability of a future market outcome.
semantics.evidence_coverage: Share of expected market observations currently represented by eligible downstream evidence; not causal certainty.
semantics.traceability: Each evidence item identifies its upstream engine and artifact so an analyst can inspect the basis of the assessment.
semantics.recommendation: The engine does not emit BUY/SELL/LONG/SHORT/PAY/EXECUTE recommendations.
